nodes.text: 心急求職，小心誤墮騙案
nodes.text_en: How to stay safe from job scams
nodes.text_sc: 心急求职，小心误堕骗案

nodes.text: 剛畢業投入職場？還是想轉工更上一層樓？
nodes.text_en: Are you fresh out of school and keen to enter the workforce? Or are you eager to look for the next best opportunity or a better paying job?
nodes.text_sc: 刚毕业投入职场？还是想换工作更上一层楼？

nodes.text: 看見薪高糧準、工時短、福利多的工作難免令人心動，但如果這份工真的好到難以置信，其實很有可能是求職騙案。
nodes.text_en: It might be tempting to see job ads that promise a big pay raise, great benefits and short hours. But if a career opportunity sounds too good to be true, it probably is.
nodes.text_sc: 看见工资高、工时短、福利多的工作难免令人心动，但如果这份工真的好到难以置信，其实很有可能是求职骗案。

nodes.text: 打開社交網站，您看到這樣的招聘廣告：
nodes.text_en: One day, you log on to social media and this job ad pops up:
nodes.text_sc: 打开社交网站，您看到这样的招聘广告：

nodes.text: 招請員工協助匯款，毋須學歷經驗，輕鬆月入數萬。申請時須提交收入證明及身分證副本。招請名額有限，馬上致電申請。
nodes.text_en: Want to make money quickly and easily? We're hiring people to help with money transfers. No experience or qualifications required. All you have to do is send us a copy of your HKID card and proof of income to apply. Limited openings. Call us now!
nodes.text_sc: 招请员工协助汇款，无须学历经验，轻松月入数万。申请时须提交收入证明及身份证副本。招请名额有限，马上致电申请。

nodes.text: 輕輕鬆鬆就月入數萬？您有點懷疑，但「筍工」可能轉瞬即逝，於是您決定打電話去問問詳情。
nodes.text_en: Making money quickly and easily sounds a bit too good to be true, but they're hiring just a few people. You don't want to miss out on a golden opportunity. It won't hurt to call and ask for details, will it? So you make the call.
nodes.text_sc: 轻轻松松就有数万元收入？您有点怀疑，但这么难得的好工作可能转瞬即逝，于是您决定打电话去问问详情。

nodes.text: 「我們的工作很簡單。我們會借用您的戶口匯款，您再將錢轉去別的戶口就可以賺佣。您只需要提交收入證明、住址證明和身分證副本，還要支付保證金，免得您收到匯款後失去聯絡。」
nodes.text_en: It's an easy job. We just need to borrow your bank account to make some money transfers. We'll deposit some money into your account, and once you've wired the money to our account overseas, you'll receive a commission. All we need is a copy of your HKID card, proof of your income, proof of your address and some cash upfront to make sure you won't run away once you've received the money for the transfers. It's just a precaution.
nodes.text_sc: “我们的工作很简单。我们会借用您的账户汇款，您再将钱转去别的账户就可以赚取佣金。您只需要提交收入证明、住址证明和身份证副本，还要支付保证金，免得您收到汇款后失去联系。”

nodes.text: 您想：「要將錢匯到我的戶口，需要提供一些個人資料和保證金，也很合理。」
nodes.text_en: You think to yourself, "They're transferring money into my account, so of course they'll need my personal details and a cash deposit. That sounds fair."
nodes.text_sc: 您想：“要将钱汇到我的账户，需要提供一些个人信息和保证金，也很合理。”

nodes.text: 於是您用手機拍下收入證明、住址證明和身分證等文件，然後打開電子支付程式，準備將保證金轉賬給您的「未來僱主」，滿心期望不用花太多力氣就可以賺錢，真好﹗
nodes.text_en: So you take a picture of your HKID card, pay statement and proof of address, and use your mobile payment app to transfer a deposit to your 'future boss'. You hope you can start this project soon as it'll bring in extra money without having to work hard. It's really easy!
nodes.text_sc: 于是您用手机拍下收入证明、住址证明和身份证等文件，然后打开电子支付程序，准备将保证金转账给您的“未来老板”，满心期望不用花太多力气就可以赚钱，真好﹗

nodes.text: 停一停，勿上當
nodes.text_en: Wait just a second – does it sound too perfect?
nodes.text_sc: 停一停，别上当

nodes.text: 慢著，先別急著開始投入「新工作」。您有沒有想過為甚麼「未來老闆」要借用您的戶口？為甚麼一開始就要您交出收入證明、住址證明和身分證副本？為甚麼上班前要先付錢？
nodes.text_en: Slow down and think. Have you ever wondered why your 'new boss' needs to borrow your bank account for transfers? Why does the company need you to give them copies of your pay statement, proof of address and HKID card at such an early stage? And why do you have to pay them before you start work?
nodes.text_sc: 慢着，先别急着开始投入“新工作”。您有没有想过为什么“未来老板”要借用您的账户？为什么一开始就要您交出收入证明、住址证明和身份证副本？为什么上班前要先付钱？

nodes.text: 您以為自己好運遇上「絕世筍工」，其實只是一頭栽進騙案之中。
nodes.text_en: The truth is: you thought you found the perfect job, but it was actually a scam.
nodes.text_sc: 您以为自己好运遇上“绝世好工”，其实只是一头栽进骗案中。

nodes.text: 您以為不付錢就沒事？隨便提供個人資料，同樣會令您被騙的機會大增！騙徒只要掌握您的銀行登入資料、近照、一次性密碼（OTP）、出生日期和身分證號碼，就可以冒用您的名義進行交易或轉賬。
nodes.text_en: They can't scam me if I don't pay them anything. Unfortunately, this isn't true. Giving out your personal information will already make you more likely to lose money. Fraudsters only need your online banking credentials, a recent headshot, one-time-passwords (OTPs), your date of birth and HKID number to complete a transaction or make a transfer in your name.
nodes.text_sc: 您以为不付钱就没事？随便提供个人信息，同样会令您被骗的机会大增！骗徒只要掌握您的银行登录信息、近照、一次性密码（OTP）、出生日期和身份证号码，就可以冒用您的名义进行交易或转账。

nodes.text: 他們更可以用您的收入證明、住址證明和身分證副本向銀行貸款，要您幫他們還錢。
nodes.text_en: In fact, all that's needed to get a loan from a bank is a copy of your HKID card, pay statement and proof of your home address. A scammer can easily apply to borrow money and leave you responsible for their debt.
nodes.text_sc: 他们更可以用您的收入证明、住址证明和身份证副本向银行贷款，要您帮他们还钱。

nodes.text: 防範求職騙案貼士
nodes.text_en: Tips to protect you from job scams
nodes.text_sc: 防范求职骗案建议

nodes.text: 即使您經常使用數碼科技，也不要以為自己一定不會上當。記得做足以下措施，謹慎分享個人資料：
nodes.text_en: Even if you're digitally savvy, you shouldn't underestimate the damage fake online job offers could cause. Follow these tips to keep your personal data safe from career scams.
nodes.text_sc: 即使您经常使用数码科技，也不要以为自己一定不会上当。记得做好以下措施，谨慎分享个人信息：

nodes.text: 申請工作時，切勿提供過多個人資料
nodes.text_en: Don't give away too much information in job applications
nodes.text_sc: 申请工作时，切勿提供过多个人信息

nodes.text: 申請工作時，不要一開始就提供住址證明及身分證副本等資料。正規的公司決定聘請您後，可能會要求您提供這些資料作背景審查，但如果有公司要您在申請工作時就向他們提供個人資料，一定要小心提防。
nodes.text_en: Details you shouldn't provide right at the beginning of a job application include proof of your home address and a copy of your HKID card. These details could be asked for later during a background check by a legitimate company. If you're asked to provide them at the start, that's a big red flag.
nodes.text_sc: 申请工作时，不要一开始就提供住址证明及身份证副本等资料。正规的公司决定聘请您后，可能会要求您提供这些资料作背景审查，但如果有公司要您在申请工作时就向他们提供个人信息，一定要小心提防。

nodes.text: 切勿提供敏感資料
nodes.text_en: Don't reveal sensitive information
nodes.text_sc: 切勿提供敏感信息

nodes.text: 千萬不要透露銀行登入資料及一次性密碼（OTP）。
nodes.text_en: Never give away information such as your online banking credentials and one-time passwords (OTPs).
nodes.text_sc: 千万不要透露银行登录信息及一次性密码（OTP）。

nodes.text: 查探空缺真偽
nodes.text_en: Check if the job opening is authentic
nodes.text_sc: 查探空缺真伪

nodes.text: 搜尋招聘廣告的電話號碼，甚至致電去查證號碼是否來自合法的公司。
nodes.text_en: Search for the phone number listed in the job ad on the web, and even call it to check if it's linked to a reliable organisation.
nodes.text_sc: 搜寻招聘广告的电话号码，甚至致电去查证号码是否来自合法的公司。

nodes.text: 了解和您對話的「公司員工」
nodes.text_en: Do a thorough check on the people you're speaking with
nodes.text_sc: 了解和您对话的“公司员工”

nodes.text: 騙徒擅長在電話上假冒身分，所以即使他們侃侃而談，向您介紹「公司」背景，也要記得查探他們的身分。您可以搜尋他們有沒有LinkedIn個人檔案、上面有沒有相片，看看他們的工作經驗和職位是否吻合。
nodes.text_en: Even if you do reach someone on the phone who seems to have legitimate information about the company, be sure to stay wary. This is because fraudsters could be using a bogus number to make their scam more convincing. For instance, check if they have a LinkedIn profile with a photograph, and if their past work experience matches the title they claim to currently hold.
nodes.text_sc: 骗徒擅长在电话上假冒身份，所以就算他们侃侃而谈，向您介绍“公司”背景，也要记得查探他们的身份。您可以搜一下他们有没有LinkedIn个人档案、上面有没有相片，看看他们的工作经验和职位是否吻合。

nodes.text: 事先了解公司資料
nodes.text_en: Do your own research on the company
nodes.text_sc: 事先了解公司资料

nodes.text: 例如公司背景、規模及地址。
nodes.text_en: Look for the firm's background information, its scale of operation and its address.
nodes.text_sc: 例如公司背景、规模及地址。

nodes.text: 不要預繳費用
nodes.text_en: Don't pay to work
nodes.text_sc: 不要预缴费用

nodes.text: 申請工作時，不要付給對方任何費用。
nodes.text_en: When applying for jobs, don't pay any fees upfront to the company or related parties.
nodes.text_sc: 申请工作时，不要付给对方任何费用。

nodes.text: 緊記不要因為心急求職，而誤墮騙局。
nodes.text_en: Remember, there's nothing wrong with being eager to find a new job or get a higher salary. Just be aware that this could make you more vulnerable to job scams.
nodes.text_sc: 紧记不要因为心急求职，而误堕骗局。

nodes.text: 如果懷疑已經遇上詐騙，請即時向我們舉報。
nodes.text_en: If you think you've already experienced a scam, don't wait any longer and report it to us immediately.
nodes.text_sc: 如果怀疑已经遇上诈骗，请即时向我们举报。
